Theorem
[Laplacian estimate for bounded heat solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0436, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0437 1. appe:1.23\group Heat Kernel Estimates

If $M$ is closed, $\operatorname {Rc}\ge -k_1g$, and $0<u\le A$ solves the heat equation, then \[ \Delta \log u+2|\nabla \log u|^2 \le \frac{k_1e^{k_1t}}{e^{k_1t}-1} \left(n+4\log \frac Au\right). \]
